items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I heard Walking with the King on Arthur Godfrey's problem. Yeah? I wonder if they got that off your record or something. [INTERVIEWEE] Probably did.

ctx.x: Well yeah. You know what I heard the other morning?
